nodes.Name: stringCache
nodes.DocComment: stringCache is a cache for strings converted from a []byte.

nodes.Name: makeString
nodes.DocComment:
makeString returns the string form of b.
It returns a pre-allocated string from c if present, otherwise
it allocates a new string, inserts it into the cache, and returns it.

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: c == nil || len(b) < minCachedLen || len(b) > maxCachedLen

nodes.Name: hash64
nodes.DocComment: hash64 returns the hash of two uint32s as a single uint32.
